notes_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Hosted API first, then Dedicated. Very cost-conscious; running a hosted POC and a cost-optimization workshop to evaluate batching, KV-prefix caching, and quantization profiles before committing to Dedicated.
detailed_notes:
- Use-case: In-app assistant + semantic search for B2B product customers. Primary workloads: streaming chat (low-latency), embeddings for search (bulk embedding jobs), model-based reranking for search results.
- Targets: 150-200ms p95 for chat at 5-10 qps; bulk embedding throughput 2000 docs/hr; cost goal: reduce per-user inference cost by 40% vs current vendor.
- Security: Requires SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS integration, audit logs, and EU data residency for ~25% of their customers.
- Demo/POC notes: Hosted API demo showed ~220ms median with small token sizes; Samir recommended enabling continuous batching for background embedding jobs and prefix caching for common system prompts.
- Cost workshop outcomes (02/05):
  * Batching: identified two batching profiles — low-latency single-user path (batch size 1-4) and high-throughput embedding job path (batch size 64-256). Estimated 3-4x token throughput improvement for embedding jobs when batched.
  * Caching: plan to use short-TTL KV cache for system prompt + KB snippets; observed 18% token reduction in replayed traffic. Action: implement per-route cache rules in POC.
  * Quantization profiles: evaluated int8 and 4-bit LLMQ profiles. Engineering comfortable with int8 in production; acceptance testing needed for 4-bit on reranking models (concerns about subtle ranking regressions).
  * Unit economics: Redwood provided a model showing net per-100k-token cost reductions of ~35% when combining batching+caching+int8 vs baseline hosted calls. Dedicated shows further 20-30% upside depending on reserved capacity.
- Stakeholders: CTO (Ava Liao) cares about accuracy regressions, Head of Product (Carlos Mendoza) cares about UX latency and cost per MAU, Procurement (Maya Singh) handling contract terms.
- Quotes from call: 'We can trade a few ms for a 30% cost drop if quality stays the same' (Carlos). 'Need an auditable KMS flow for EU keys' (Ava).
- Risks: procurement timing (end of Q1 budget), potential accuracy regressions from aggressive quantization on reranking, need for EU region Dedicated nodes for residency.
- Action items: Redwood to deliver Dedicated sizing & pricing spreadsheet, run 4-bit acceptance tests on reranker snapshots, provide SOC2 artifacts and SSO setup guide, enable per-route caching config in POC by 2026-02-12.
sales_notes:
- Pricing convo: asked for 12-month reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go; prefer predictable unit economics. Mid-market price sensitivity; likely to start with a modest Dedicated commit if POC meets targets.
- Proposed commercial: 12-month Dedicated pilot with quarterly review + Hosted fallback for burst. Provide a worked example showing cost per MAU at 100k, 250k, 500k monthly tokens.
- Close plan: technical acceptance (POC) -> procurement term negotiation -> legal review -> sign Dedicated pilot (forecast 2026-03)
